description: This file appears to be an HTML webpage that sets up the CodeMirror editor to support Textile syntax highlighting mode. It includes linkage to external CSS and JavaScript resources, and contains sample Textile markup in a textarea element for editing and previewing Textile formatted text.

methods.name: CodeMirror.fromTextArea
methods.description: Initializes a CodeMirror editor on a textarea element with specified options like line numbering and Textile mode.
